title: What is a Feature
text:
A Feature is a general concept in software engineering. 
It refers to a functional unit with independent business value provided by a software system to users. 

In software engineering, a feature typically refers to a complete business capability. 
It can be independently planned, developed, tested, and delivered. 
It is a function point that is visible and perceivable to users. 

In the AIM project's reverse construction feature repository, features have the following characteristics. 
Features are complete business capabilities that can solve specific problems or meet specific needs for users. 
Features can be independently described, designed, developed, and delivered. 
Each feature has a clear value proposition that brings actual benefits to specific user groups. 
Features form a complete traceability chain with requirements, design, implementation, and testing.
textTranslate:
特性（Feature）是软件工程中的通用概念。 
它指的是软件系统为用户提供的、具有独立业务价值的功能单元。 

在软件工程中，特性通常指系统提供的一个完整的业务能力。 
可以独立规划、开发、测试和交付的功能单元。 
用户可见和可感知的功能点。 

在AIM项目的反构特性库中，特性具有以下特点。 
特性是一个完整的业务能力，能够为用户解决特定的问题或满足特定的需求。 
特性可以独立描述、设计、开发和交付。 
每个特性都有明确的价值主张，能够为特定用户群体带来实际收益。 
特性与需求、设计、实现、测试形成完整的追溯链路。

title: Components of a Feature
text:
A complete feature typically includes the following elements. 
Feature description clearly defines what the feature is and what business capabilities it provides for which users in what scenarios. 
Feature value explains the specific benefits and advantages brought by the feature. 
Function list is a list of all function points included in the feature. 
Boundary design clarifies the system boundary of the feature through UML use case diagrams and other methods. 
Functional design includes detailed business processes and implementation design for each function. 
Dependency relationships refer to dependencies and impact relationships with other features. 
Security analysis covers security threats and control strategies involved in the feature.
textTranslate:
一个完整的特性通常包括以下要素。 
特性描述清晰定义特性是什么，为哪类用户在什么场景下提供什么业务能力。 
特性价值说明特性带来的具体收益和好处。 
功能列表特性包含的所有功能点清单。 
边界设计通过UML用例图等方式明确特性的系统边界。 
功能设计每个功能的详细业务流程和实现设计。 
依赖关系与其他特性的依赖和影响关系。 
安全分析特性涉及的安全威胁和控制策略。

title: Feature vs Function vs Requirement
titleTranslate: 特性 vs 功能 vs 需求
text:
There are important distinctions between requirements, features, and functions. 
A requirement is a problem or expectation raised by users, and it is the source of features. 
A feature is a complete business capability unit that meets requirements, and it is the carrier of design and development. 
A function is an independent function point within a feature, and it is a component of the feature. 

For example, Knowledge Base Evaluation is a feature. 
It includes multiple functions such as Create Evaluation Task, Execute Evaluation, and View Evaluation Results. 
These functions together fulfill the requirement of providing users with knowledge base quality assessment capabilities.
textTranslate:
需求、特性和功能之间存在重要区别。 
需求（Requirement）是用户提出的问题和期望，是特性的来源。 
特性（Feature）是满足需求的完整业务能力单元，是设计和开发的载体。 
功能（Function）是特性内部的独立功能点，是特性的组成部分。 

例如，知识库评测是一个特性。 
它包含创建评测任务、执行评测、查看评测结果等多个功能。 
这些功能共同实现了为用户提供知识库质量评估能力这个需求。

title: What is a Feature Repository
text:
A Feature Repository is a general concept in software project management. 
It refers to a knowledge base that centrally stores and manages feature documents. 

As a knowledge management practice, feature repositories are typically used in software projects to centrally manage feature documents and related information. 
They maintain the classification and organizational structure of features. 
They track the status and dependencies of features. 
They support feature retrieval and reuse. 

The reverse construction feature repository in this project is implemented in the following ways. 
Structured storage organizes features by functional domain and technical level. 
Standardized templates use unified document templates to ensure consistent feature descriptions. 
Version management records the evolution history and revision records of features. 
Relationship management maintains dependencies, impacts, and mutual exclusion relationships between features.
textTranslate:
特性库（Feature Repository）是软件项目管理中的通用概念。 
它指集中存储和管理特性文档的知识库。 

特性库作为一种知识管理实践，在软件项目中通常用于集中管理特性文档和相关信息。 
维护特性的分类和组织结构。 
跟踪特性的状态和依赖关系。 
支持特性的检索和复用。 

本反构特性库采用以下方式实现。 
结构化存储按照功能领域和技术层次对特性进行分类组织。 
标准化模板使用统一的文档模板确保特性的描述规范一致。 
版本管理记录特性的演进历史和修订记录。 
关系管理维护特性之间的依赖、影响、互斥等关系。

title: What is Reverse Construction
text:
Reverse Construction is a specific term used in this project. 
It refers to the process of reverse sorting and extracting feature design information from implemented systems or code. 

Reverse construction belongs to the category of Reverse Engineering and Documentation Reconstruction. 
Reverse engineering derives design information from implemented systems. 
Documentation reconstruction supplements and improves missing or incomplete documentation. 

In this project, reverse construction specifically refers to a reverse process. 
Unlike the traditional forward flow from requirements to design to implementation, reverse construction is a reverse process from implementation to design to documentation.
textTranslate:
反构（Reverse Construction）是本项目使用的特定术语。 
它指从已实现的系统或代码中，反向梳理和提取特性设计信息的过程。 

反构属于逆向工程（Reverse Engineering）和文档重构（Documentation Reconstruction）的范畴。 
逆向工程从已实现的系统推导出设计信息。 
文档重构补充和完善缺失或不完整的文档。 

在本项目中，反构特指与传统的从需求到设计到实现的正向流程不同，反构是从实现到设计到文档的逆向过程。

title: Why Reverse Construction is Necessary
text:
In actual project development, the following situations often occur. 
Historical code lacks documentation, as early development did not have complete feature design documents. 
Documents are out of sync with implementation, causing documentation to lag behind code implementation and become inaccurate. 
Knowledge is scattered, with feature-related information dispersed in different places such as code, emails, and meeting records. 
Personnel changes occur, with original designers leaving, causing design ideas to be lost. 

Through reverse construction, feature information can be extracted from existing systems. 
Feature documents can be supplemented and improved. 
Documentation consistency with implementation can be ensured.
textTranslate:
在实际项目开发中，经常出现以下情况。 
历史代码缺乏文档，早期开发时没有完整的特性设计文档。 
文档与实现不同步，文档滞后于代码实现，导致不准确。 
知识分散，特性相关信息分散在不同地方（代码、邮件、会议记录等）。 
人员变动，原始设计人员离开，导致设计思路丢失。 

通过反构，可以从现有系统中提取特性信息。 
补充和完善特性文档。 
确保文档与实现的一致性。

title: The Reverse Construction Process
text:
The reverse construction process includes the following steps. 
Identify feature boundaries by recognizing independent features from code structure and functional modules. 
Sort function lists by analyzing all function points included in features. 
Extract business logic by understanding the business scenarios and user value of features. 
Organize dependency relationships by analyzing dependencies and impacts between features. 
Document by organizing into feature design documents according to standard templates.
textTranslate:
反构的过程包括以下步骤。 
识别特性边界从代码结构、功能模块中识别独立的特性。 
梳理功能列表分析特性包含的所有功能点。 
提取业务逻辑理解特性的业务场景和用户价值。 
整理依赖关系分析特性之间的依赖和影响。 
文档化按照标准模板整理成特性设计文档。

title: Feature Design Document
text:
A Feature Design Document is a general concept in software projects. 
It is used to record detailed design information about features. 

In different projects, feature design documents may have different templates and structures. 
However, they typically include feature descriptions and value statements. 
They include function lists and boundary definitions. 
They include detailed functional designs. 
They include dependency relationships and impact analysis. 
They include security considerations. 

In this project, feature design documents are written according to the AIM Feature Template V2.0 standard. 
They include specific sections such as feature description, value, function list, and boundary design. 
They include detailed design for each function. 
They include project scenario support and feature dependencies. 
They include threat models and security control strategies.
textTranslate:
特性设计文档（Feature Design Document）是软件项目中的通用概念。 
用于记录特性的详细设计信息。 

特性设计文档在不同项目中可能有不同的模板和结构。 
但通常包含特性描述和价值说明。 
功能列表和边界定义。 
详细的功能设计。 
依赖关系和影响分析。 
安全考虑。 

在本项目中，特性设计文档按照AIM-特性模板 V2.0标准编写。 
包含特定章节，如特性说明、价值、功能列表、边界设计。 
每个功能的详细设计。 
项目场景支持、特性依赖。 
威胁模型、安全控制策略。

title: Feature Status
text:
Feature Status is a general concept in software project management. 
It is used to track the progress of features in their lifecycle. 

In different project management methods, features may be marked with different statuses. 
Common statuses include Backlog or Planned. 
In Progress or In Development. 
Testing or Review. 
Done or Released. 
Cancelled or Archived. 

In this project, features may be in the following states during their lifecycle. 
Planned means the feature has been proposed but design has not yet started. 
In Design means the feature design document is being written. 
In Construction means design is complete and development is in progress. 
Completed means development is complete and has been delivered online. 
Archived means the feature has been deprecated or is no longer maintained.
textTranslate:
特性状态（Feature Status）是软件项目管理的通用概念。 
用于跟踪特性在生命周期中的进展。 

在不同项目管理方法中，特性可能被标记为不同的状态。 
常见状态包括待办（Backlog）或规划中（Planned）。 
进行中（In Progress）或开发中（In Development）。 
测试中（Testing）或验收中（Review）。 
已完成（Done）或已发布（Released）。 
已取消（Cancelled）或已归档（Archived）。 

在本项目中，特性在生命周期中可能处于以下状态。 
规划中特性已提出但尚未开始设计。 
设计中正在编写特性设计文档。 
建设中设计完成，正在开发实现。 
已完成开发完成，已上线交付。 
已归档特性已废弃或不再维护。

title: The Value of Feature Documentation
text:
Feature design documents serve multiple important purposes in software projects. 
They are records of design decisions and rationale. 
They serve as a basis for team collaboration and communication. 
They enable knowledge transfer and preservation. 
They support project management and tracking. 

In this project, feature design documents are not just records of design. 
They are the basis for team collaboration. 
They enable knowledge inheritance. 
They serve as the foundation for project management. 

Through standardized feature documentation, scattered feature information can be systematized. 
This forms searchable, traceable, and reusable knowledge assets. 
It helps teams understand the system better. 
It facilitates maintenance and evolution of the system.
textTranslate:
特性设计文档在软件项目中具有多重重要价值。 
它们是设计决策和理由的记录。 
它们是团队协作和沟通的基础。 
它们实现知识传承和保存。 
它们支持项目管理和跟踪。 

在本项目中，特性设计文档不仅是设计的记录。 
它们是团队协作的依据。 
它们实现知识传承。 
它们是项目管理的基础。 

通过标准化的特性文档，可以将零散的特性信息体系化。 
这形成可检索、可追溯、可复用的知识资产。 
它帮助团队更好地理解系统。 
它促进系统的维护和演进。
